## Purity Rules Enforced

The following impurity vectors were explicitly checked:

✅ No time access (`time`, `datetime.now`, clocks)  
✅ No randomness (`random`, UUID generation outside inputs)  
✅ No IO (`print`, logging, files, network)  
✅ No global state reads  
✅ No caching or memoization  
✅ No mutation (enforced by ADR‑OP‑001)  
✅ No hidden dependencies  
✅ Explicit dependency injection only
